decisions.text: slices largest first, clockwise from 12 o'clock: West, South, Central, East, North
each slice its own colour, handed out in slice order (D-22 (a)): West series-1, South series-2, Central series-3, East series-4, North series-5
each slice named outside it, its value under the name, formatted as one set (G7.27, D-51 (ii)): $728K, $510K, $306K, $275K, $248K
no outlines: true gaps 1.0 pt wide between the slices (G7.26s: 0.7 % of the diameter)
comment 1 (“The West had the highest expenses!”) in empty space beside the plot, 1 arrow to West (G8.7)
the maker's comments in New Computer Modern italic, in the reserved blue, set apart from the labelling and outside its count of text styles (G6.3, D-19)
the four questions answered: what matters: comment 1 (not answered: why care, what explains it, what to do, which need be answered only where known) (G8.3)

source.shows: the cheat sheet's pie: the insight stated in a comment beside the chart, in New Computer Modern italic in the reserved blue with a thin arrow into the West's slice, set apart from the labelling and outside its count of text styles (R5-5, G6.3, G8.7); the slices as any pie's, the values in thousands as one set (G7.27)
